body.statement: There exist constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) such that \(c r_n\le\mathfrak R_n\le C r_n\) for all sufficiently large \(n\); equivalently, \(\mathfrak R_n\asymp\{\log\log n/\log n\}^{\beta-1/2}\).
body.justification: The matching expected-maximal-width frontier is the theorem-level statistical contribution.
body.gap: No cited work matches an honest ADRF sup-band upper bound to a fixed-nuisance marked lower bound under fully blind asymmetric replicates with spectral zeros.
body.consumer: Study designers can translate the frontier into sample-size calculations for resolving clinically or economically meaningful dose-response features.
